# Placeable — what a map may legally contain

Generated from `SPAWN_REGISTRY`, `scripts/core/depth.py` and
`config/inputs.json`. This document answers *authoring* questions;
for what a behavior DOES see [`BEHAVIORS.md`](BEHAVIORS.md), and for
why something is inert see [`DIAGNOSE.md`](DIAGNOSE.md).

## Object `type` values that spawn

The `Type` field on a tmx object. An object whose type is not in
this table makes the **whole map raise at load** — deliberately,
because a skipped object looks like a working one.

| `type` | default depth | spawned as |
|---|---|---|
| `GamePlayer` | 50 | `GamePlayer` |

## Names that look placeable and are not

`scripts/core/depth.py`'s `OBJECT_CONVERTER` maps these to a depth,
which reads as a list of placeable classes. It is not one — a depth
mapping is not a registration. Measured against the tree:

| name in `OBJECT_CONVERTER` | `class` exists in `scripts/`? | spawnable? |
|---|---|---|
| `GameBackgroundEntity` | **no** | no |
| `GameEntity` | yes | no |
| `GameFloorEntity` | **no** | no |
| `GameForegroundEntity` | **no** | no |
| `GameUIEntity` | **no** | no |

5 of 6 entries are not spawnable. Put one in a `Type` field and the map raises.

## The tmx property vocabulary

| property | meaning |
|---|---|
| `pyoneer_behaviors` | comma-separated behavior tokens, on the OBJECT |
| `pyoneer_param_<key>` | one behavior parameter |
| `pyoneer_actor` | actors-table row id, read from `data/project/tables/actors.json` |

Every custom property starts `pyoneer_`. The prefix is not style:
pytmx raises and makes the whole map unloadable if a property
shadows one of its own attribute names.

Registered behavior tokens (see [`BEHAVIORS.md`](BEHAVIORS.md) for
what each one does and whether it is wired):

    action_relay animation_drive attack_action interact_action lifecycle_mark pause_action platformer_move player_input topdown_move

## Input verbs

Bound in `config/inputs.json`. A behavior polling a verb that is
not here raises at attach — add the binding in the same change.

| verb | bindings |
|---|---|
| `action` | `keyboard:e`, `gamepad:b` |
| `attack` | `keyboard:left_shift`, `gamepad:x` |
| `down` | `keyboard:s`, `gamepad:down` |
| `jump` | `keyboard:space`, `gamepad:a` |
| `left` | `keyboard:a`, `gamepad:left` |
| `pause` | `keyboard:escape`, `gamepad:start` |
| `right` | `keyboard:d`, `gamepad:right` |
| `sprint` | `keyboard:left_ctrl`, `gamepad:right_bumper` |
| `up` | `keyboard:w`, `gamepad:up` |
